subject.title: chore(deps): bump the swift-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Should this grouped macOS dependency update merge on direct source review plus passing focused CI, or be held until a signed-app smoke covers the Peekaboo bridge and Sparkle updater?
rationale: The patch and exported package contracts are coherent, but deciding whether compilation and security guards adequately cover production updater and privileged automation behavior requires owner risk acceptance.

options.title: Smoke Then Merge
options.body: Refresh the branch and validate Peekaboo bridge startup plus Sparkle updater availability in a signed macOS app before merging.

options.title: Accept Current Evidence
options.body: Merge after refreshed focused checks, explicitly accepting that the signed updater and automation runtime were not exercised.

options.title: Split The Updates
options.body: Pause the grouped PR and request separate Peekaboo and Sparkle updates if maintainers want independent review and rollback units.

recommendation.title: Smoke Then Merge
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and validate Peekaboo bridge startup plus Sparkle updater availability in a signed macOS app before merging.
